events.description: President Donald Trump and his Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. have long tried to reduce the number of vaccinations available to the US public and even farm animals. The latest move in context.
events.ticker_label: 💥 US vaccination executive order: making sense of it

events.title: Trump pushes overhaul of US policy on vaccines for children
events.description: In an executive order, President Trump calls for fewer recommended childhood vaccinations and more spacing between shots. Medical experts say the changes lack scientific backing and could leave children less protected.

events.title: Why the Rhine drought is bad news for Germany's recovery
events.description: Germany’s inland waterways still move around 5% of the nation's goods. With the Rhine at a critically low level, DW explores how the drought is hitting the economy where it hurts most.

events.title: Russia frees ex-US marine after four years imprisonment on disputed charges
events.description: A former US military veteran who was imprisoned in Russia for more than four years on disputed charges and under abusive conditions was released on Tuesday. A group advocating for him said he was gravely ill and at risk of dying.

events.title: Parisians get ready for the eclipse
events.description: Paris is preparing for the solar eclipse. The last one here in France was in 1999. So this is one not to miss, especially for the astrophotographer we met.

events.title: Miscarriages triple, healthcare access worsens… the nightmare for pregnant women in Gaza
events.description: With over 3,950 cases recorded by the ministry of health in Gaza, the number of miscarriages between January and June has tripled compared with the previous six months. During this period, there was approximately one miscarriage for every five live births. The Observers team spoke with two OBGYN doctors in Gaza.

events.title: Dozens of migrants who crossed into Ceuta reached mainland Spain, Sky News told
events.description: Dozens of migrants reached the Spanish mainland after entering Ceuta during the mass influx into the enclave, police sources have told Sky News.

events.title: 'I think we know I won't be getting bail,' suspected cartel boss tells judge
events.description: Daniel Kinahan has been remanded in custody after appearing before an Irish court charged with directing an organised crime group.

events.title: Record number of people arrive on one small boat - but what's behind fall in Channel crossings this year?
events.description: A record 230 people crossed the English Channel in a single boat on Monday.

events.title: Vietnam’s VinSpace signs deal with SpaceX to launch its first satellites in 2027

events.title: Florida woman accused of faking cancer to scam hundreds out of $40K, police say
events.description: A Florida woman was arrested after she allegedly scammed more than 200 people out of $40,000 with a fake cancer diagnosis. GoFundMe says it refunded the money.

events.description: A United Nations-backed survey found no widespread acute malnutrition in Gaza, prompting Israel's ambassador to call prior famine claims a blood libel.

events.title: Netanyahu rejects Board of Peace's Gaza plan: No 'withdrawal until Hamas is genuinely disarmed'
events.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejects the Board of Peace's 15-point Gaza proposal, demanding Hamas surrender all weapons before any withdrawal.

events.title: Gen Keane questions whether Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Qatar can be trusted in Iran talks
events.description: Retired Gen. Jack Keane accuses Pakistan, Qatar and Saudi Arabia of being compromised mediators who steer Trump away from military pressure on Iran.
